title: E-mail spoofing pack (P027, CR01-CR03)
notes: P027 cond 3: the DNS facts CR01-CR03 consume (produced by email_security_posture/dns_records; first declared by batch p1-G01-1 with the same descriptions). Only NOERROR/NXDOMAIN-backed facts are written; could-not-verify answers leave them unset (rule 5).

attributes.spf_lookups: int: DNS-mechanism lookups of the SPF evaluation (include, a, mx, ptr, exists, redirect; RFC 7208 limit 10)
attributes.spf_void_lookups: int: void lookups (NXDOMAIN or no records) of the SPF evaluation (RFC 7208 limit 2)
attributes.dmarc_pct: int: DMARC pct= tag (0-100) of the applicable policy
attributes.dmarc_sp: DMARC sp= tag (subdomain policy): none | quarantine | reject
attributes.dmarc_rua_external: list of {dest_domain, authorized}: DMARC rua/ruf destinations outside the organisational domain and whether <domain>._report._dmarc.<dest> authorises them (true/false; null = could not verify)
